display_name: CORE-P1-OUTCOME-FEEDBACK — outcome and feedback schema bridge
implementation_state: A validated Outcome boundary keeps planned, last-attempted, and served identity distinct, classifies terminal success, failure, cancellation, and interruption without reclassification, and converts to a canonical lossless OutcomeTrainingSample through pure deterministic adapters. Absent feedback stays None and a non-success outcome can never become a success training label. Accepted on dev at b99baa4; production emission remains owned by CORE-P1-PIPELINE-LIFECYCLE.

Attempt identity and terminal status preservation
Outcome/schema tests, workspace ML tests, clippy, and diff check
